services.desc: Want to see one of Chesapeake Bay's most beautiful lighthouses without the crowds? This private cruise takes you and up to five friends from Grimstead straight to the newly restored New Point Comfort Lighthouse. We're talking about a peaceful ride through some of the bay's prettiest waters, with plenty of time to soak in the views and learn why this lighthouse has been guiding sailors for over two centuries. Perfect for families who want something different, or anyone looking to get away from the hustle and see a piece of Virginia's maritime history up close.
